WITH part_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND ps.ps_size = 15
  GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT 
  s.s_acctbal,
  s.s_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment
FROM part p
JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p.p_size = 15
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
  AND (
    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) 
    FROM partsupp ps2
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  )
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100

WITH part_min_cost AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND ps.ps_size = 15
  GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT 
  s.s_acctbal,
  s.s_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment
FROM part p
JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey

    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,

FROM

SELECT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM
    lineitem
WHERE
    l_receiptdate <= DATE '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus
ORDER BY
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus

        SELECT
            ps.ps_partkey,
            SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS value
        FROM partsupp ps
        JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
        GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
    ),
    total_value AS (

    )

    FROM german_supplier_value
    WHERE value > (SELECT total_value FROM total_value)
    ORDER BY value DESC
